upstream.scope: Generic server-promoted selection and reveal for List, Table and Tree collections (§6.3, §7.4, §7.6, §8, §22.5, §22.7, §22.8): the standard value property names an ItemId only, store rules shared by Rust and Swift with conformance vectors, an SDK promotion API with explicit failures and delete settlement, and generic native AppKit selection, one-time reveal and accessibility notification; no Process Explorer feature work and no application-specific client path

entries.feature: A List, Table or Tree holds a server-promoted selection in its standard value property (registry property 13) as an ItemId; no registry, proto or codegen change. The Rust and Swift stores refuse, identically on every replica, a value that is not an ItemId (a row index is never a selection) and a promotion held while selection_mode is none or absent, including disabling selection while promoted; an uncached ItemId is not a replica error
entries.scope: PX-011-G01/semantic-tree store (store/mod.rs validate_collection_selection, Node::promoted_selection), Swift SemanticStore.validateCollectionSelection, conformance vectors 50-53 in suite 01

entries.feature: SDK UiTransaction::promote_selection and List/Table/Tree::promote_selection refuse an unknown ItemId with ItemNotFound (no row-index fallback), selection_mode none, a non-collection or model-less node, and otherwise record a one-item MODEL_RESET_RANGE carrying the authoritative item followed by SET_PROPERTY(value = ItemId); clear_promoted_selection withdraws it

A MODEL_DELETE that removes the promoted item clears the promotion in the same commit unless the transaction re-inserts that ItemId (a move under sorting keeps it); settle_promoted_selections runs on every SDK and sessiond commit, and a resync snapshot restores the promotion and its item
entries.scope: PX-011-G01/sdk selection.rs PromotionTracker, sdk/session.rs, sessiond/session.rs transaction_with_result, sessiond/session/snapshot.rs test

entries.feature: The generic AppKit renderer selects the promoted ItemId's NSTableView/NSOutlineView row and scrolls it into view once per promotion operation, posts the selectedRowsChanged accessibility notification, does not echo SELECTION_CHANGED, keeps a later local click local (SELECTION_CHANGED emitted, not overwritten by unrelated or structural commits), lets a later promotion replace it, maps an absent ItemId to no row and waits until the item arrives through the range machinery, and restores the promotion on remount, resync and reconnect without re-revealing an unchanged one
entries.scope: PX-011-G01/client-macos Collections TableCollectionAdapter, OutlineCollectionAdapter, CollectionPromotion; RendererAppKit CollectionSelectionPromotion.swift, LayoutRenderer; Tests/RendererAppKitTests/CollectionSelectionPromotionTests.swift
